chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Maymūn narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: "A boy and a boy, a boy and a girl, and a girl and a girl are to be separated from one another in sleeping places at ten years."
ai.seo_question: At what age should children be separated in their sleeping arrangements according to hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling about children’s sleeping arrangements once they reach the age of ten. It instructs that children should be separated in their beds, covering different pairings of boys and girls, as part of proper family conduct and upbringing.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4509 - Abdullah ibn Maymun narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), from his forefathers (peace be upon them), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: "A boy and a boy, a boy and a girl, and a girl and a girl should be separated in their sleeping arrangements at the age of ten years."
